name: adtraction-mcp
description: Adtraction (ads): me, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_adtraction_api_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ADTRACTION_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_adtraction_api_token.description: Adtraction advertiser API token (log in to Adtraction > Account > Settings), sent as the X-Token header; it determines the advertiser program the calls see.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v2/advertiser/account/: the advertiser program behind the token ({programId, programName, currency, market}).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST /v2/advertiser/statistics/days/ {fromDate, toDate, transactionStatus: 3}: the program's statistics per day with approved + pending transactions (transactionStatus 3). `spend` is `cost` (partner commission plus platform fee, in the program currency). `account_id` is not sent (the token selects the program) and `campaign_id` is not applied (Adtraction has no campaigns; the optional channelId filter is a partner channel).
